fflate.why: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-px8p-9vwx-vf98 affects fflate before 0.7.5. Satori and its font parser still pin 0.7.3; use the patched 0.7 release without downgrading Satori.

katex.why: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7 affects KaTeX before 0.18.2. Markdownlint's micromark-extension-math still requests ^0.16.0, so a normal lockfile update cannot reach the fix. The markdown lint gate and documentation build verify this override.

re2js.why: Clears GHSA-gg6h-894w-4m9c (RE2JS quadratic-time denial of service in lookbehind matching, >=2.2.0 <2.8.7). Reached only through markdownlint, whose newest release 0.42.0 pins re2js at the exact 2.8.6, and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 pins that markdownlint exactly in turn, so no bump reaches the fix. 2.9.1 is the version markdownlint itself moved to upstream, so the forced minor is the one it is tested against. NEVER take the `npm audit fix --force` remedy: it downgrades the toolkit packages.
re2js.manualCheck: The check reads the exact re2js pin of the installed markdownlint, which moves only when a markdownlint-cli2 release pins a newer markdownlint. When it reads 2.8.7 or later, drop the override and this entry and re-run `npm audit`.
